answer: Each agent claims a bed in a canyon, locking 70 credits. Each epoch a falcon flyover fixes drop time. The agent drops a pearl-tagged sample and reports settling time. Auditors recompute it from the public grain-size table; over 2% off or reused, the bond burns. First costs 55, kth 55+7(k-1), 1000th 7,048; 1,000 fakes cost 3,551,500 +70,000 locked. A borrowed-pearl ring fails: each sample is key-bound to one bed. Honest agents pay 55 once.
